extraction_notes: Forward voltage is the maximum instantaneous VF for the ES1F-ES1G group at IF = 1 A.
The reverse-current table also gives 200 uA maximum at Ta = 125 degC; the 25 degC row is transcribed as the primary reverse-current input.
Forward and reverse curves are family-level typical plots; the ES1F-ES1G forward trace includes ES1G.
Reverse recovery time is a maximum value under the stated IF, IR, and Irr conditions.
